title: E-SPN-0074: a string that reads the love-fear pair through the flux, a STAND-IN on locked tokens: paid from a store...
purpose: Experiment E-SPN-0074 in the spin arena: a string that reads the love-fear pair through the flux, a STAND-IN on locked tokens: paid from a store (a joint copy past what the store holds bounces), it is an integer, reversible, role-blind rule that binds the love-fear pair in every channel the fear beat cannot see and three loves as three, and the bound pair still travels ballistically; charged as a phase omega^span instead it cannot confine (about a third of the weight escapes, a = 0.64), because a phase is periodic in the length: in discrete time only a count confines.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
